title: Linh Sơn Temple
scope: The principal 1940 Buddhist sanctuary and connected rear hall of Chùa Linh Sơn in Đà Lạt, with the two entrance pillars, front steps, and adjacent octagonal tower.
limitations: Main sanctuary extents align with the named OpenStreetMap building. The side tower and entrance columns have approximate positions and dimensions inferred from multiple ground photographs.
Rear doors, gold-painted ornament and dragon sculpture profiles are simplified. Parts beyond the central sanctuary, tower and principal access steps fall outside the modeled scope.
